prompt: Create exactly one reusable Milo character-performance candidate on true transparent alpha. Image 1 is canonical identity; image 2 supplies the owner-preferred berry-pose head/torso balance. Preserve canonical head size, ear silhouette, grey needle-felt wool, green eyes, cream muzzle/chest, charcoal nose, orange tail, short sturdy limbs and lean non-bulging waist. Readable upper chest and short natural neck transition, shoulders below jaw; no long neck, shortened torso, inflated head or belly. Restrained three-quarter screen-right body view, neutral studio light, closed mouth, no visible teeth. Full-body pose with complete ears, feet, hands and tail inside frame with margins, both feet on one support plane. No scenery, ground, shadows, props, text, watermark or duplicate characters. Stand holding one later-staged acorn at waist height, cupped hands with relaxed shoulders; head faces forward-right and eyes attentive to surroundings. Render empty grip space rather than a new acorn design.

inputs.scope: Identity, base anatomy, intrinsic palette and felt only
Owner-endorsed proportion target; full asset approval not inferred
